faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support I position is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support I position at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a DMLT with 2 years of relevant experience or a BSc in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT) with 1 year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Technical Support I role?
faq.answer: The salary for this position will be as per ICMR norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply by sending their application via email.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support I post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Does AIIMS Delhi provide age relaxation?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation, as it is not explicitly mentioned in the provided data.
